data.summary: Every figure I checked matches Microsoft's fiscal 2024 10-K: revenue of $245.1B (vs. $211.9B in FY2023), net income of $88.1B, operating income of $109.4B, total assets of $512.2B and cash and cash equivalents of $18.3B. As you asked, I didn't review the revenue growth percentage. One thing to note: the two revenue figures work out to about 15.7% growth, not 24.7%, so you may want to look at that figure again.
